notes:
New in v2.3.2:

Licensing redesign: no registration required to use the app. Unregistered users get the Free tier automatically. Registering unlocks a 6-month Pro trial (all modules including payroll). After trial: subscribe or stay on Free.

Budget improvements: Net Profit row in all budget tables; unified single-table layout for budget vs actual report; budget tile moved to Financials hub.

Dashboard: window title shows company name; sidebar logo centred; upcoming jobs panel capped at 4 with scroll.

Tax return: embedded tax estimate panel appears inline when tax estimate is configured.

Bug fixes: payroll routes now correctly accessible on Pro/trial licences; job status correctly synced when stage changes via all code paths.
